valid_from.description: ISO 8601 time the fact became true; default now. Back-dated facts close and are closed by their neighbours.

at.description: ISO 8601 time the fact stopped being true; default now

mode.description: recall=find related, composition=build solution from parts

dry_run.description: If true, only show what would be merged

hard.description: Erase permanently instead of hiding; cannot be undone

threshold.description: Cosine similarity threshold for embedding match.

type.description: Entity type: person, technology, project, company, ...

limit.description: Cap how many scenarios to run.

action.description: list: show pending sessions. get: return transcript data. complete: mark as done.

dry_run.description: If true, only show what would be affected

detail.description: 'summary' truncates content to 150 chars, 'full' returns everything

ids.description: Knowledge record IDs (max 50 per call; extras are silently dropped)

node.description: Node name or ID to explore

types.description: Filter by node types (rule, skill, concept, etc.)

id.description: Knowledge record ID to get history for

tool_name.description: Which tool triggered this (Write, Edit, Bash, etc.)

embedding_space.description: Optional: only re-encode rows in these spaces.

branch.description: Filter by git branch (also includes branch-agnostic records)

context_max_chars.description: Context character budget; evidence mode uses the same value as a stricter UTF-8 byte budget.

decisions_only.description: Return only structured decisions (v8.0): type=decision AND tags contain 'structured'. Results include parsed schema payload under 'decision'.

detail.description: Level of detail: 'compact' ~50 tokens/result (id+title+score), 'summary' truncates content to 150 chars, 'full' returns everything, 'auto' picks based on query complexity (paths/urls/code → full, short → compact). Ignored when mode!='search'.

diverse.description: Enable MMR diversity to reduce redundant results (useful for broad queries)

entities.description: Filter by extracted entity names (technology/person/project, case-insensitive)

evidence_followup.description: Evidence mode: allow one search for an explicitly supplied missing_relation.

expand_budget.description: Max number of additional records to include via graph expansion

expand_context.description: Add graph-related records (1-hop neighbors via knowledge graph) as 'expansion' results

fill_budget.description: Context mode: search deeper (up to 100 hits) and keep whole hits in rank order until context_max_chars is used, instead of excerpting the top `limit` hits to fit. Neighbours default to 0 here; pass `neighbors` to keep each hit with the records around it.

fusion.description: Score fusion method: 'rrf' = Reciprocal Rank Fusion (better multi-tier ranking), 'legacy' = original additive scoring

missing_relation.description: Evidence mode: missing relation; subject must occur in the original question.

mode.description: Progressive-disclosure mode: 'search' (default) = normal results, 'index' = ultra-compact metadata only (id+title+score+type+project+created_at, ~40-60 tok/hit, no cognitive expansion, use memory_get(ids=...) to fetch full content), 'timeline' = chronological compact view; 'context' = source excerpts; 'evidence' = indexed passage search with bounded follow-up retrieval

neighbors.description: Timeline/context modes: records before/after each hit; context accepts 0–3.

rerank.description: Enable CrossEncoder re-ranking for higher precision (adds ~30ms latency)

topics.description: Filter results to records tagged with any of these topics (from deep enrichment)

include_llm_summary.description: Add an LLM-written paragraph (needs a configured LLM)
include_llm_summary.title: Include Llm Summary

offset.description: day/week/month only: 0 = current, -1 = previous (yesterday, last week, last month)
offset.title: Offset

period.description: day = today, week = this ISO week, month = this calendar month, all = since the first record, custom = since/until
period.title: Period

project.description: Project name; omit for all projects
project.title: Project

save.description: Also write the Markdown under <memory dir>/reports/
save.title: Save

since.description: custom only: first day YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive) or an ISO date-time
since.title: Since

tz.description: IANA timezone for period boundaries, e.g. Europe/Berlin; default: MEMORY_REPORT_TZ, TZ or the system zone
tz.title: Tz

until.description: custom only: last day YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive) or an ISO date-time (exclusive); default today
until.title: Until

agent_id.description: Optional Claude Code subagent ID (x-claude-code-agent-id header / OTEL agent_id attribute, v2.1.139+). Lets recall trace which subagent produced this knowledge.

branch.description: Git branch this knowledge relates to

coref.description: Opt into v10 coreference rewrite — expand pronouns ('after this it broke') into self-contained text using recent session history. Costs ~1s LLM round-trip; default off.

filter.description: Optional content filter (pytest|cargo|git_status|docker_ps|generic_logs). Trims noisy CLI output while preserving URLs/paths/code.

importance.description: Recall-time boost: critical x1.5, high x1.2, medium x1.0, low x0.8. Reserve `critical` for migration-blocking decisions and security incidents.

parent_agent_id.description: Optional parent agent ID (the dispatching Agent tool / parent span). Together with agent_id forms the subagent lineage tree.

source_format.description: Conversation preserves dialogue structure and bypasses automatic CLI filters.

supersede.description: Retire active records of the same project and type that this one gives a new value for: same opening words, different trailing value ("X's citizenship is Argentina" -> "... is Armenia"). Use for single-valued facts only; "likes jazz" would retire "likes rock". The retired ids are returned as `superseded`.

parent_agent_id.description: Optional parent agent ID (the dispatching span)

supersede.description: Same as memory_save.supersede: retire records this one gives a new value for.

embedding_space.description: Filter to one or more embedding spaces (text|code|log|config).

anchor.description: ISO datetime anchor for relative phrases

find.description: Search query to find the old knowledge (when no id)

id.description: Exact record to replace; takes precedence over find

project.description: Limit the find search to this project

phase.description: Phase name or null to clear.

selected.description: Chosen option name (must be in options)

session_id.description: Session id (defaults to current MCP session)

query.description: Substring to match in prompt text

context.description: What was being done when error occurred

description.description: What went wrong: symptom, expectation vs reality

fix.description: How it was fixed (empty if unresolved)

source_error_ids.description: Error IDs that spawned this (for add)

reflection.description: What went well, what to improve, what to do differently

task_summary.description: Brief description of what was done

categories.description: Error categories relevant to current task

phase.description: Optional: lazy-load only rules relevant to this phase (core + phase-specific). Omit to get all rules.
